MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing fits the wiring work suggested by my battery holder, relay, and circuit board purchases because it helps insulate the connections I make.",
    "The smaller caliper would help me measure components and mounting dimensions, giving me a practical tool for the small electronics projects reflected in my history."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The 3D printer and filament assume I want to start printing parts, but my electronics purchases do not establish that need, and I have no current use for filament.",
    "Another caster set feels unnecessary after my recent caster purchase, especially when the recommended wheels are larger and I have no new application for them.",
    "The gloves, ten-pack of glue, larger caliper, and inspection camera lack a specific job for me right now; the nut assortment also needs a thread-size match before it becomes useful."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop equipment, even when it serves a different task.",
    "Buying casters once seems to have been treated as a reason to buy more, without considering that the recent purchase may already satisfy that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I care about how an item helps with a concrete step in my projects, such as insulating wire connections or checking component dimensions.",
    "Size, compatibility, and quantity matter: a compact measuring tool fits my work better than extra range, hardware must match my threads, and bulk supplies need a clear purpose.",
    "I choose items selectively when I can identify a current use; something being potentially useful for DIY work is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my DIY interests but often missed the specific tasks, dimensions, and immediate needs that make an item worth choosing."
}
